content.short: Constructor Encoder is a Deth Tools toolset for Ethereum (EVM) developers, enabling ABI injection and reading data from smart contracts.
content.description: Constructor Encoder is a tool for smart contract analysts and developers to explore the underlying architecture of decentralized applications. Developers can inject the ABI from smart contracts and read data directly from them, helping to clarify contract interfaces and data flows. The toolkit also includes calculators, data converters, vanity address generators, and decoders to support comprehensive developer analysis. It is designed to be approachable for analysts while providing precise access to contract metadata.
